page.overview:
Who is Sukune?

Sukune is a -ranked wrestler from Wano Country. He is the older brother of Urashima.

Like his brother, Sukune is a very large man with a downward-pointed nose and small eyes. He short dark hair that fans out behind his head and is tied into a topknot, thick eyebrows, and a thick mustache and beard.

Little is known about Sukune's personality, but it can be assumed that he likes , having trained in the sport enough to be promoted to . His mood after the match against Yamato can also indicate a healthy sense of sportsmanship, carrying no ill will towards his former opponent.

Sukune appears to be skilled at , being elevated to the highest rank, . His rank further suggests great physical strength, though it was still inferior to Yamato's.
